headline: Meeting canceled for lack of quorum; no votes taken, but upcoming presentations and the meeting schedule were discussed.
summary: The meeting was canceled for lack of quorum. Two members were present, and no votes were recorded. The agenda listed upcoming presentations, including Sept 22 with ACLU CT, and a proposal to set meetings on the 2nd Thursday of each month.

TOWN OF HAMDEN, CONNECTICUT 
 
Human Rights & Relations Commission 
Minutes         
         
Regular Meeting 
 
7:00 PM, September 10, 2026 
  
 
Hamden Government 
Center 
Third Floor Conference 
Room 
2750 Dixwell Avenue 
Hamden, CT  06518 
Tel:  (203) 287-7070 
Fax:  (203) 287-7075 
 Click to View Agenda   
  
1. CALL TO ORDER   
 B&C clerk Porsche Edmundson was present at 7:00 pm via Zoom.  
The meeting was canceled for lack of quorum.  
2. ATTENDANCE   
 B&C clerk Porsche Edmundson took attendance. 
Present: Chair Claudia LeSueur and Dana Parmelee Guzman.  
3. PUBLIC COMMENT   
 
 
4. APPROVAL OF PREVIOUS MEETING MINUTES   
 
 
  1. Approval of minutes for both July and August, after minor changes were made.  
  
 
5. CORRESPONDENCE   
 
 
  1. Update on Library Presentation RSVPs.  
  
 
6. REPORTS   
 
 
  1. Social Media Posts and Posters for Sept 22 Presentation; Reception Plans.  
  
 
7. EXECUTIVE SESSION 
(if recommended by the town attorney)  
 
 
8. OLD BUSINESS
1. Sept 22 - Plan Your Vote Presentation with ACLU CT. 
Oct 20 - Teen Violence Prevention Presentation with Dave Wolffe. 
Nov 17 - IRIS Presentation CONFIRMED and  
Police Chief Reynold is CONFIRMED to attend the Oct 8 Meeting. 
   
  
 
9. NEW BUSINESS   
 
 
  1. Confirm annual meeting dates, for the 2nd Thursday of each month at 7:00 pm. 
Unless otherwise noted.   
  
 
10. ADJOURNMENT   
 No quorum was present.  
The meeting will be held at the end of September.  
Notes taken by: B&C Clerk Porsche Edmundson
